gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL. Build: Colour & lighting controls with predicted swatches, per-lever toggles and Broadcast / Retail resets. Off in every preset; settings persist with the project.

input_constraints: Seven pinned .rdata light tables (0x120 bytes each) behind the retail selector and installer. Ambient, key, fill and white balance use the existing owner; directions, counts and shadow bytes stay retail. Night and dome share one table.
477 pinned stadium bundles: field SCNE, detail_normal, divots and Fldd tint. Fixed spans and retail wrappers remain unchanged. Unfit spans retain retail bytes and their receipts name the limitation.

Custom settings are validated finite values with bounded ranges. Each slider and group has an Off switch. End-zone and outside colour follow turf unless unlinked. Map contrast only adjusts variation already encoded in a colour map.
Regrading needs the original retail source. Same-recipe builds can replay only recognized bytes; custom status requires its own per-bundle receipt. Default retail/modern pins are unchanged.

PREDICTED turf uses the calibrated map-times-rig model. Wear, bump detail, tints, stripes and edge shade are outside the mean model. Dome, material turf, afternoon, rain, snow and alternate rigs are extrapolations.
portme: Witness custom settings in day, afternoon, night, dome, rain and snow games; check whites and skin, painted end zones, outside grass, mowing contrast and far-field shimmer at matching resolution.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute authoring tools, values and verified recipes only. Never bundle a retail roster, executable, disc or texture.

runtime.scope: Offline custom parameter writes, decode read-back, byte-preserving wrappers, swatch calibration and offscreen project save/reload. The approved v2.1 Broadcast baseline is retained. New custom settings, other stadium/condition predictions and shimmer behaviour remain UNWITNESSED.

fields.allowed: nfl2k5_colour_lighting/v1 project document; 55 bounded numeric controls, group switches, per-control disabled list, surface links and preview selectors

selectors.notes: Option remains Off in all presets. Broadcast resets project controls to v2.1; Retail resets every lever to its retail value. To change or reset an already-graded disc, choose its original retail source. Custom status is applied (custom) with a matching .colour-lighting.json receipt.

summary: Tune stadium turf, linked end zones and outside grass, divot contrast, bump flattening, time-of-day tints and seven existing light rigs. Preview the calibrated mean turf colour, save custom project settings and build with fixed-span receipts.
